world.title: Sanctuary 7
world.subtitle: Nature remembers. So do we.
world.format: 60–90 second vertical adventure → long-form → game world
world.seasonQuestion: Can something still be wild if its survival depends on human intervention?
world.premise: Every animal in one of East Africa's last great wildlife refuges begins moving east at the same time. Nia Adera arrives that morning and receives a message from her scientist mother, missing for three years: if the animals are moving, they have found the door.
visualIdentity: beauty before danger: golden grasslands, deep forest and enormous skies
natural landscapes dominate frame; technology feels intrusive
predator and prey moving together is the signature impossible image
underground infrastructure is concrete, corroded and monumental
soundIdentity: wind, insects, distant elephants and changing bird density
unnatural low-frequency vibration beneath natural ambience

characters.name: Nia Adera
characters.role: Daughter of missing ecologist Dr. Amara Adera
characters.essence: Compassionate, resilient and initially emotionally detached from conservation.
characters.appearance: Young Kenyan woman, dark skin, natural braided or twisted hair, expressive observant face.
characters.wardrobe: Urban-influenced field clothing at first: faded blue overshirt, earth-toned trousers, practical boots.
characters.voice: Young Kenyan English, direct and emotionally contained.
continuityRules: She should initially look slightly out of place in the field.
Clothes gradually weather over later episodes, not within pilot.

characters.name: Jabari Hassan
characters.essence: Skilled, guarded and deeply literate in animal behaviour.
characters.appearance: Young East African man, dark skin, lean field build, observant eyes.
characters.wardrobe: Olive and sand ranger utility clothing, worn practical boots.
characters.voice: Quiet East African English; speaks only when he has something useful to say.
continuityRules: Keep ranger uniform practical and non-military.

characters.name: Dr. Amara Adera
characters.essence: Brilliant, idealistic and morally compromised by what she helped build.
characters.appearance: Kenyan woman in her late forties, intelligent tired face, natural hair with subtle grey.
characters.wardrobe: Washed khaki and practical research fieldwear.
characters.voice: Calm older Kenyan female voice recorded under stress; scientific precision with maternal warmth underneath.
continuityRules: Before physical reveal, represent her through voice, photos and objects.

characters.name: Koda
characters.essence: Emotional anchor and living clue to the sanctuary's hidden history.
characters.appearance: Young African elephant with a small tear in the left ear and an old tracking collar.
characters.voice: Natural elephant vocalization; distinct low contact rumble.
continuityRules: Left-ear tear must always remain on the same ear.

episode.title: The Migration
episode.episodeQuestion: Why are predator and prey moving together in the same direction?
episode.payoff: The migration was predicted by Nia's missing mother three years earlier.
episode.cliffhanger: Her mother's message says the animals are moving because 'they've found the door.'
episode.firstFrame: A lion and zebra moving in the same direction through golden grass, neither reacting to the other.
